finding.status: source-confirmed; precise regression ready, execution pending
finding.title: A completed background source save loses its automatic placed-link refresh on the next Pen preview
workflow: Place a native document in another open document.
Edit the source and start Background Save.
Switch to its placing document and drag a second Pen anchor.
Let save completion refresh the placed link.
Continue the drag; Session::preview restores the pre-refresh interaction snapshot.
finding.cause: refresh_placed calls links::update through Session::edit while the target has an interaction. This mutates only the live document. The next preview replaces it with Interaction.doc, which still holds the old placed key and link metadata.
finding.proof: SaveJob::complete -> refresh_placed -> update -> Session::edit/install_document updates the live placed key. Pen Drag -> Action::Preview -> Session::preview restores Interaction.doc. No refresh-path operation rebases or finishes the interaction.
finding.negative_expectation: The test first requires the refreshed key to differ from the old key. On current source its final PlacedDocument equality should fail after the next Drag/Up restores the old snapshot. Expected result only; no executed negative claimed.
finding.baseline: Residual behavior in the composed candidate; not attributed to the native IncludeLinked fix.
